secondary_endpoints.role: Replication of primary at longer horizon
secondary_endpoints.threshold_rationale: Replication requires positive IC, not necessarily exceeding 0.005

steps: 1. Compute raw p-values for H-10 and H-20 incremental IC tests
2. Order p-values from smallest to largest: p(1) <= p(2)
4. If p(1) < 0.025, compare p(2) to alpha/1 = 0.05
5. If both pass, family-wise null is rejected
6. If p(1) >= 0.025, family-wise null is not rejected
holm_bonferroni_implementation.deterministic_ordering: p-values sorted ascending; ties broken by experiment ID lexicographic order
holm_bonferroni_implementation.missing_experiment_handling: Missing experiment remains missing; not excluded from family

model_consistency_check.rationale: Lasso provides supporting evidence, not formal replication
model_consistency_check.interpretation: If Lasso incremental IC > 0, it supports Ridge findings

promotion_prohibition: H-20 must NOT be promoted to primary status regardless of outcome
